content.problemStatement: Write a program to reverse a string except the special characters
content.outputFormat: Print the reverse of the string

solution.approach: Two-pointer reverse swapping only alphanumeric characters while preserving special characters.

editorial.overview: Use pointers left = 0, right = N - 1. Increment left if not alnum, decrement right if not alnum, else swap.
